Category: Super Luxury • Fabrication: DV29 - 60,000eb - 12 Months

Humanity Loss: N/A (None) • Install: Mall

Relic is an interface and component of Arasaka's experimental, flagship project publicly known as "Secure Your Soul." It uses the concept of personality transferal by converting the data in the human nervous system into a digitized engram and stored as a construct on the Relic biochip. The purpose of "Secure Your Soul" is the ability — currently only available to the wealthiest clients — to communicate with deceased loved ones. Their personality constructs, which are preserved on the Relic biochip mean that in practice, death is no longer the ultimate barrier. However, it doesn't take a genius to realize that the potential for the Relic technology is much higher — Arasaka currently is not sharing any information on its further plans for the program.

Iconic Chipware. It can have the full personality and memories of any individual loaded onto it, which is done by the usage of a special Arasaka program to stream their consciousness into a digital copy. Having this procedure done is nigh impossible to do, requiring at minimum Reputation Rank 9, 1,000,000eb, and a very good relation with Arasaka. This copy is loaded onto a Relic 1.0 Biochip and, once inserted into a user’s shard slot, can be communicated with as if the stored personality was a digital avatar that only the user can see. This could be used to talk to deceased characters or any other figure the GM decides resides on that specific Biochip. This version of the biochip has no other function or bonus.

Fabrication: DV29 - 60,000eb - 12 Months
Type: Neuralware
Install: Mall
Option Slots: uses 0

Foundry notes:

  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Super Luxury benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Cyberware).
